messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT PAGER — GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION in gcp-us-west1 (severity: P1)
incidents-bot: Queue growth observed on /generate with sustained 95% GPU utilization across pool-gpu-wus1. Autoscaler attempts failing with quota errors. -> https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-3482
Sam L: I'm on it, joining bridge. seeing lots of 429s from autoscaler and 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient quota' in allocator logs.
Priya K: Confirmed. Autoscaler reconcile logs: `error: quotaExceeded for nvidia-tesla-a100, region us-west1` at 12:02:15.
Jordan (oncall): I'm taking lead for mitigation. Priya, can you post the allocator error block?
Priya K: paste: ```2026-03-15T12:02:15Z allocator.go:421] claim failed: quotaExceeded: limit=1800 requested=32 region=us-west1 project=redwood-prod```
Sam L: Traffic spike from a few high-throughput customers + internal batch jobs. Queue length on frontend up 8x.
Iris - cloud-ops: GCP quota dashboard shows quota hit on GPUs for project redwood-prod in us-west1. Current limit 1800, usage 1800. No immediate quota increase available (quota requests show pending).
Maya (cust-success): We have a notified enterprise customer (acct: NovaMaps) with errors; customer success already flagged they're seeing timeouts. Should we notify broader CS?
Jordan (oncall): Yes Maya, please start a short customer note: "We're experiencing GPU capacity issues in us-west1 that may impact latency. We're mitigating and will update in 30m." Keep it high level.
Sam L: Mitigations I can try now: 1) route non-latency-sensitive traffic to us-west2/eu-west1 via gateway rules 2) enable smaller GPU model variants (vram-optimized -> 8-bit quantized) 3) pause internal batch jobs.
Priya K: Autoscaler fallback isn't happening because allocation stage fails before instance creation. Gateway reroute looks fastest.
Ravi (devex): For routing, I can flip the per-customer region policy for NovaMaps and the public spiky bucket to us-west2. Need thumbs from Jordan.
Jordan (oncall): Do it. Prioritize customers with highest SLA. Add a header `X-Redwood-Region: us-west2` for those routes.
Iris - cloud-ops: Opening GCP support ticket and quota escalation (case 123456789). ETA from GCP unclear; escalation to PM may give 2-4h. For immediate relief, we can: a) claim spare committed capacity in us-west2 and spin up replicas b) enable preemptible GPUs in us-west1 for burst pools c) temporarily scale down model size.
Sam L: Let's do a + b: route burst to us-west2 and enable preemptible pool in us-west1 for non-critical requests. Priya, can you prepare the terraform change to create preemptible pool?
Priya K: On it. Patch: ```resource "google_compute_instance_template" "gpu_preempt" { machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g" scheduling { preemptible = true } }``` Will submit quick PR to infra repo.
Jordan (oncall): Also pause internal batch jobs now. Sam, please toggle the batch flag.
Sam L: Pausing `batch/az-benchmark` now. ```curl -X POST https://api.internal/flags/pause -d '{"job":"batch/az-benchmark"}'``` -> 200 OK
Ravi (devex): Routing rule change in gateway submitted: `patch /routes/region-priority` -> added rule: if customer in high-sla-list and origin us-west1 then prefer us-west2. Deploying.
Maya (cust-success): Sent customer note for NovaMaps. Awaiting escalation channel if they ping support.
Priya K: Preemptible pool PR merged, applying. Terraform plan looks good. Spinning up 12 nodes in us-west1 preemptible pool.
incidents-bot: Deployment event: infra-deploy/2026-03-15-12:10 by priya_k — created preemptible pool (12 nodes) in us-west1
Sam L: Gateway routing completed, we see decreased queue growth for high-sla requests. Metrics: /generate p95 latency for NovaMaps down from 18s -> 3.2s after reroute.
Jordan (oncall): Good. Next: get a longer-term capacity fix and customer comms. Iris, what's the ETA on quota increase from GCP?
Iris - cloud-ops: Support replied: escalation created, human review queue. Possible quota bump in 4-12h. They asked for usage pattern and committed spend. I've added details and asked for interim quota grant.
Priya K: I'm still seeing some `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` for low-priority requests; preemptible pool handles ~60% of burst. We should also enable model fallback to `redwood-small-q4` for best-effort traffic.
Sam L: Rolling model fallback config now: `POST /admin/route-configs/fallbacks {"route":"/generate","fallbacks":["redwood-small-q4"]}` -> success.
Jordan (oncall): Customer impact summary so far: - High-SLA customers: mitigated via us-west2 routing, near normal service - Best-effort customers: higher latency / some 429s while preemptible pool stabilizes - Internal jobs: paused. Action items: 1) follow up with GCP quota 2) monitor preemptible stability 3) schedule postmortem on runbook gaps.
Maya (cust-success): Notified affected customers with the mitigation note and expected update in 4h.
Ravi (devex): Quick thought: we should add a feature into gateway to auto-failover region when alloc errors indicate quota. Filing ticket: DE-1219.
Priya K: Logs: after routing & preemptible nodes, queue length dropped by 70% in 8 minutes. No new allocation errors for high-sla traffic.
Jordan (oncall): Handing off to daytime oncall @Sam L for continued monitoring. I'll update incident channel and close pager. If anything degrades, page back.
Jordan (oncall): Summary pinned to incident tracker and runbook stub created: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-3482/notes
Sam L: Acknowledged handoff. Keeping watch for 2h. If GCP doesn't grant interim quota, next step is temporary account-level reshuffle of committed capacity.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity downgraded to P2 at 12:40 after mitigation steps.
Maya (cust-success): Thanks team. I'll coordinate post-incident outreach for affected customers.
Iris - cloud-ops: GCP responded requesting detailed TPU/GPU usage CSV; sending now. Also scheduling a sync with account rep.
Priya K: Filing follow-up runbook edits: add automatic reroute when allocator returns quota errors, add preemptible pool playbook, and add customer comms templates.
Ravi (devex): Noted action DE-1219 and will prototype region-failover hook next sprint.
Sam L: Logging final notes in the ticket and will run through postmortem template after 72h for data.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (monitoring) at 12:54.
